{{Quote|Never...send a clone to do the proper job of an anthropophagite.|Sarsius Torne's wistful reflection on the Battle of Skye|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Sarsius Torne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Thyrsian]] who served as a [[Sun Guard]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] for [[Zeta Magnus]]. Based deep in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], Torne was stationed at [[Rennek palace|Rennek Palace]] at the heart of the [[Dark Worlds]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Thyrsian]], Sarsius Torne was trained as a [[Sun Guard]] and found employment deep within the [[Dark Worlds]] as a servant to the crazed [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]. Serving as the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] for Magnus's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Zeta Magnus's clone army|army]], he trained [[Tark Squad]], a set of four [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] that were designed to infiltrate the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as part of Magnus' deal with [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to recover [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
